limmat.name: Limmat
limmat.authors_source: copyright notice and README of the archive
limmat.license_source: Permission notice of the archive, a three-clause BSD licence, signed Armin Biere, Computer Systems Institute, ETH Zurich
limmat.comment: The solver of the SAT 2002 competition, in its own release series.  This release predates the competition output format, so a launcher turns its answer and its bare assignment lines into the s and v lines; the 2002 image prints them itself.
